metadata.description: TokenWise — measurement-driven model router for Claude Code. Routes Haiku/Sonnet/Opus, measures real dollars saved per session.

plugins.name: tokenwise
plugins.description: Measurement-driven model router for Claude Code. Routes subtasks to Haiku/Sonnet for grunt work, reserves Opus for synthesis, logs token usage per task class to a local NDJSON, and proves savings via on-demand A/B tests. Auto-detects whether routing/env-var primitives work on your Claude Code build before configuring. Exposes /tokenwise:install, /tokenwise:report, /tokenwise:summary, /tokenwise:ab, /tokenwise:undo.
